inquest.m: An inquiry into the cause of an unexpected death.

inquests.m: An inquiry into the cause of an unexpected death.

inquietude.m: Feelings of anxiety that make you tense and irritable.

inquiringly.e: Tom Swift looked at his cabin mates inquiringly.

inquisition.m: A severe interrogation (often violating the rights or privacy of individuals).

inquisitions.m: A severe interrogation (often violating the rights or privacy of individuals).

inquisitive.e: If someone saw a man climbing a light post they might get inquisitive.

inquisitor.m: A questioner who is excessively harsh.

inquisitorial.m: Especially indicating a form of prosecution in which proceedings are secret and the accused is questioned by a prosecutor who acts also as the judge.

inquisitors.m: A questioner who is excessively harsh.
